answer: A first payout is released only after three established sponsors, who have never co-signed one another, endorse the new key. The endorsement window opens at dawn and lasts six hours; each sponsor may sign at most two newcomers per epoch, and every signature is posted to a public cedar roster. The newcomer's first eight payouts then rest on a settlement ledge and are clawed back if any two of those sponsors later appear together on a different key's roster. A farm must recruit a fresh, non-overlapping sponsor triple for every clone, because established agents ration their two scarce slots.
